blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep learning models for chest X-ray anomaly detection remain vulnerable to subtle distributional shifts (e.g., acquisition technique, patient-related factors, and preprocessing). Traditional error analysis often relies on semantic metadata or model embeddings, which can mask low-level signal variations that degrade performance. In this work, we propose a data-centric framework for automated failure mode discovery using spectral analysis. We project images into the frequency domain and extract a compact profile summarizing the distribution of signal energy across frequency bands. By performing unsupervised clustering on these spectral profiles, we demonstrate that model failures are not randomly distributed, but are strongly concentrated within specific spectral clusters. This method effectively isolates "blind spots", enabling the prediction of model reliability and the discovery of performance-degrading data slices without requiring ground-truth failure annotations.
blocks.zh: 胸X射线异常检测的深层学习模型仍然容易受到微妙的分布性转变(如获取技术,与患者相关的因素,以及预处理)的影响. 传统的错误分析往往依赖于语义元数据或模型嵌入,这可以掩盖能降解性能的低等信号变异. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个利用光谱分析进行自动化故障模式发现的数据中心框架. 我们把图像投射到频率域 并提取一个紧凑的剖面图 总结信号能量在频率段的分布 通过在这些光谱剖面上进行不受监督的集群,我们证明了模型故障不是随机分布的,而是被强烈集中在特定的光谱集群内. 这种方法有效地将"盲点"隔离出,使得能够预测模型的可靠性并发现能分解性能的数据片而无需地面-真实故障说明.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Deep learning has achieved remarkable success in the interpretation of chest X-rays (CXRs), where algorithms now frequently match or exceed radiologist performance in controlled settings Katzman et al. (2024) ; Bettinger et al. (2024) .
However, in the context of clinical deployment, models often fail to generalize to data that deviates statistically from their training distribution, resulting in significant and unanticipated performance degradation Zech et al. (2018) ; Yu et al. (2022) .
Ensuring the reliability of these systems requires the ability to anticipate and identify failure modes before they impact patient care.
blocks.zh:
深度学习在胸X射线(CXR)的判读上取得了显著成功,目前算法在受控环境下经常与克兹曼等(2024)相匹配或超过放射学家的性能; Bettinger等(2024).
然而,在临床部署方面,模型往往无法概括到统计上偏离其培训分布的数据,导致显著而出乎意料的性能退化了Zech等人(2018年);Yu等人(2022年)。
确保这些系统的可靠性需要有能力在故障模式影响病人护理之前进行预测和识别。

blocks.en:
Two main approaches have been explored to isolate underperforming samples from unseen data. Metadata stratification uses sensitive categorical attributes to spot biases in the system Gichoya et al. (2023) , while model-centric techniques examine the embedding of models, either to spot out-of-distribution samples Hong et al. (2024) or to cluster coherent underperfoming slices in the datasets Olesen et al. (2024) .
However, both metadata stratification and latent space analysis operate on high-level semantic abstractions and fail to capture subtle signal-level shifts and irregularities that drive performance degradation.
blocks.zh:
已探索出两种主要方法,将表现不佳的样本与未见数据相分离。 元数据分层法使用敏感绝对属性来区分Gichoya等人(2023年)系统中的斑点偏差,而以模型为中心的技术则研究模型的嵌入问题,或者在数据集中发现分层外样本Hong等人(2024年),或者在数据集中集成连贯的分层分层 Olesen等 (2024) (英语).
然而,元数据分层和潜在的空间分析都以高层次的语义抽象为主,无法捕捉到微弱的信号级变化和导致性能退化的不正常现象。

blocks.en:
Therefore, in this work, we propose a data-centric framework that prioritizes signal characteristics over semantic features or metadata labels.
Inspired by recent studies in the field of domain adaptation and generalization Wang et al. (2020) ; Xu et al. (2021) , we hypothesize that some systematic model failures correlate with specific profiles in the frequency domain.
From the Fourier transform of an image, we compute a compact representation that summarizes the distribution of signal energy across frequency bands.
In that representation space, we apply an unsupervised clustering method to partition validation data into spectrally coherent subgroups.
Our experiments demonstrate that these spectral clusters might act as predictors of model reliability.
We show that model failures are not uniformly distributed, but are concentrated within specific spectral clusters and effectively reveal ”blind spots” in the model’s generalization capability.
This approach allows for the identification of performance-degrading data slices rooted in image physics, enabling predictive reliability estimation without the need for ground-truth failure annotations.
blocks.zh:
因此,在这项工作中,我们提出一个以数据为中心的框架,将信号特性置于语义特征或元数据标签之上。
受最近关于域名适应和概括的Wang等人(2020年);徐等人(2021年)的研究的启发,我们假设一些系统模型故障与频率域的具体剖面有关。
从一个图像的傅里叶变换中,我们计算出一个紧凑的表示,总结了信号能量跨频段的分布.
在这个代表空间里,我们采用了一种不受监督的集群方法,将验证数据分成光谱相通的分组。
我们的实验表明,这些光谱集群可能起到预测模型可靠性的作用。
我们显示,模型故障不是统一分布的,而是集中在特定的光谱集群中,并有效揭示模型通化能力的"盲点".
这种方法可以识别植根于图像物理学的性能降级数据片段,从而能够进行预测性可靠性估计而无需地面真实故障说明.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Slice Discovery in medical image datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 医疗图像数据集中的切片发现

blocks.en:
To identify systematic failures, the standard approach for medical applications consists in slicing validation data by categorical attributes Seyyed-Kalantari et al. (2020) ; Larrazabal et al. (2020) ; Ahluwalia et al. (2023) .
Although essential for fairness auditing, this approach is entirely based on the availability of tabular data.
It remains blind to ”hidden stratification” Oakden-Rayner et al. (2020) , where performance degrades due to signal-level characteristics that are not recorded in clinical logs.
blocks.zh:
为了识别系统性的失败,医疗应用的标准方法包括用Seyyed-Kalantari等人(2020年)、Larrazabal等人(2020年)、Ahluwalia等人(2023年)的绝对属性进行分解验证数据。
这种做法虽然对公平审计至关重要,但完全基于表列数据。
Oakden-Rayner等人(2020年)仍然对“隐藏分层”视而不见,其性能因临床记录中没有记录的信号级特征而退化。

blocks.en:
Beyond categorical attributes, Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection uses feature space distances to spot anomalies Lee et al. (2018) ; Liu et al. (2020) and is also widely explored in medical image applications Tardy et al. (2019) ; Berger et al. (2021) ; Roy et al. (2022) ; Araujo et al. (2023) .
Although effective in identifying stark outliers, these methods struggle with subtle variations in image acquisition that degrade performance without triggering distance-based alarms Wiles et al. (2021) .
blocks.zh:
除了绝对属性外,Out-Dissibution(OOD)检测还使用特征空间距离来发现异常的Lee等(2018年);Liu等(2020年),并在医学图像应用中被广泛探索. Tardy等 (2019年); Berger等 (2021年);Roy等 (2022年); Araujo等 (2023年).
这些方法虽然能够有效识别明显的外向,但在获取图像时却遇到了微妙的变化,这些变化降低了性能,而没有触发基于距离的警报。 威尔斯等 (2021).

blocks.en:
To uncover coherent high-error subsets of data, recent unsupervised methods apply clustering algorithms in the latent embedding space of models Eyuboglu et al. (2022) ; d’Eon et al. (2022) ; Olesen et al. (2024) .
However, this approach faces a technical paradox: deep networks are explicitly optimized to be invariant to nuisance variables Achille and Soatto (2018) .
Consequently, the latent space often suppresses the irregularities that cause model failure, rendering these failure modes invisible to latent space clustering strategies.
blocks.zh:
为了发现一致的高error数据子集,最近未经监督的方法在模型Eyuboglu等人(2022年)、d-Eon等人(2022年)、Olesen等人(2024年)的潜在嵌入空间中应用了集群算法。
然而,这一方法面临着一个技术悖论:深层网络被明确优化,使其对干扰变量Achille和Soatto(2018年)不具有多样性.
因此,潜在的空间往往压制导致模型故障的不正常现象,使潜在的空间集群战略看不到这些故障模式。

blocks.en: 2.2 Frequency domain analysis in deep learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 深度学习中的频率域分析

blocks.en:
In this work, we look for failure modes in the frequency domain of the images, to remove metadata supervision and dependence on subjective model embeddings to focus only on the intrinsic irregularities of the signal.
Important studies on image frequencies have been conducted in domain generalization (DG) Huang et al. (2021a) ; Zhao et al. (2022) and domain adaptation (DA) Huang et al. (2021b) ; Yang et al. (2022) to increase the robustness of deep learning models with respect to frequency perturbations.
These methods alter either the low frequencies Guo et al. (2018) or the high frequencies Wang et al. (2020) of the images to train models on adversarial examples in a data augmentation scheme.
Although not directly related to our approach, the success of these techniques brings evidence that some failure modes of deep learning models are explained by characteristics of the Fourier spectrum of input images.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们寻找图像频域中的故障模式,去除元数据监管和对主观模型嵌入的依赖,只专注于信号的内在异常.
在域通化(DG)Huang等人(2021a)中进行了关于图像频率的重要研究; Zhao等人(2022年)和域名适应(DA)Huang等人(2021年b; 杨等 (2022年),提高深度学习模式在频率扰动方面的稳健性.
这些方法要么改变图像的低频率出郭等(2018年),要么改变高频率出王等(2020年),以在数据增强计划中以对抗性实例训练模型.
虽然与我们的方法没有直接关系,但这些技术的成功带来了一些证据,说明一些深层学习模型的失败模式是由傅里叶频谱输入图像的特点所解释的.

blocks.en:
Unlike DG and DA approaches that manipulate spectra to train robust models, we utilize spectral analysis as a post-hoc diagnostic tool.
This allows us to cluster data based on image physics rather than semantics, exposing signal-driven failures that escape standard monitoring.
blocks.zh:
与操纵光谱来训练强力模型的DG和DA方法不同,我们利用光谱分析作为后热诊断工具.
这使得我们能基于图像物理学而不是语义学来分组数据,暴露出逃避标准监测的由信号驱动的故障.

blocks.en: We employ the RAPS profile to compress images into compact, rotation-invariant vectors, ensuring that downstream clustering tasks focus on intrinsic statistics rather than superficial variations in object pose.
blocks.zh: 我们使用RAPS剖面将图像压缩成紧凑的自转-变量向量,确保下游集群任务侧重于内在统计而不是物体外观的表面变化.

blocks.en:
To ensure comparability across images, all Fourier spectra must lie on the same frequency grid.
We therefore restrict the analysis to images of similar native resolution and enforce identical spatial dimensions using minimal spatial cropping.
This avoids spectral distortions: resizing modifies high-frequency content through interpolation, while padding artificially increases low-frequency energy.
A minimal uniform crop preserves the relevant spectral structure and maintains the physical interpretation of Fourier frequencies.
blocks.zh:
为了确保图像之间的可比性,所有傅里叶光谱必须位于同频格上.
因此,我们把分析限制在类似本地分辨率的图像上,并使用最低限度的空间裁剪来实施相同的空间维度。
这避免了光谱扭曲:通过插值重新调整高频含量,而加成则人为地增加低频能.
最低限度的统一作物保持了相关的光谱结构并保持了傅里叶频率的物理解释.

Unlike the Euclidean distance, which is sensitive to absolute magnitude, the correlation distance is invariant to additive and multiplicative shifts in signal intensity.
This ensures that vectors are grouped based on their intrinsic spectral morphology rather than physically irrelevant variations in global energy or sensor gain.
Consequently, the clustering process effectively isolates stable structural features, such as relative sharpness (shape of the high-frequency tail), sensor or reconstruction noise patterns (boosting of high frequencies), as well as characteristic spectral slopes of specific imaging devices, while remaining robust to acquisition-level scaling and offsets.

与欧几利得相去相去甚远,对绝对相去甚远的绝对相去甚远,相去甚远的相去相去相去甚远,对信号强度的添加和多相相相去相去甚远.
这确保了向量根据其内在的光谱形态分类,而不是在全球能量或传感器增益方面与物理无关的变化。
因此,集群过程有效地隔离了稳定的结构特征,如相对的锐度(高频尾部形状),传感器或重建噪声模式(高频的激发),以及特定成像设备的特有光谱坡度,同时坚固到获取级的缩放和抵消.

blocks.en: 3.3 K-medoids clustering
blocks.zh: 3.3 K-medoids 分组

blocks.en: In a first exploratory phase, we use the standard K-medoids clustering to validate the relevance of RAPS descriptors for performance analysis. As it is not specifically optimized for slice discovery, it allows unbiased exploration of the relationship between the frequency domain and model failures. The possibility of varying the number of clusters is also convenient to confirm an observed tendency across partitions of different granularities.
blocks.zh: 在第一个探索阶段,我们利用标准的K-medoids集群来验证RAPS描述符对性能分析的相关性. 由于它没有专门为切片发现进行优化,它允许对频率域与模型故障之间的关系进行无偏见的探索. 改变星团数量的可能性也便于证实不同颗粒分界线之间观察到的趋势。

blocks.en: 3.4 Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering (HAC)
blocks.zh: 3.4 分层群集

blocks.en:
To optimize the slice discovery process, we resort to a hierarchical clustering technique.
In a bottom-up fashion, each radial profile starts as an individual cluster and we iteratively merge the closest pairs of clusters according to the average linkage rule.
To partition the resulting dendrogram we set the 0.5 0.5 -quantile of the distribution of pairwise distances as a threshold to stop the merging procedure.
Adopting this strategy gives three key advantages.
First, the partition scale naturally adapts to the inherent variability of the spectral representations.
Second, it circumvents the limitation of pre-specifying an arbitrary cluster count.
Finally, this flexibility effectively optimizes the isolation and discovery of specific underperforming slices.
blocks.zh:
为了优化切片的发现过程,我们采用了分级集群技术.
以自下而上的方式,每个光圈剖面从一个单个集群开始,我们根据平均链接规则迭接地将最接近的对集群合并.
为了分割由此产生的凹槽,我们设定了双相距离分布的0.5-方位作为停止合并程序的门槛。
采取这一战略有三个关键优势。
第一,分出比例表自然适应了光谱表达的内在可变性.
第二,它规避预先说明任意集群计数的限制。
最后,这种灵活性有效地优化了特定性能不佳切片的隔离和发现.

blocks.en: 3.5 Outliers
blocks.zh: 3.5 用户

blocks.en:
In accordance with standard agglomerative clustering protocols, outliers were defined as observations or small terminal groups that remained isolated until the final stages of the hierarchy.
Specifically, we classified any cluster containing fewer than 10 10 samples as an outlier group, as these represented spectrally atypical profiles with linkage distances significantly exceeding the primary fusion thresholds.
To maintain statistical robustness and ensure sufficient sample sizes for downstream analysis, these isolated profiles were aggregated into a single composite outlier category. \color black
blocks.zh:
根据标准群集协议,外层被定义为观测或小终端组,这些组在分层的最后阶段之前一直被隔离.
具体地说,我们把任何含有不到10个样本的组群归类为超常组群,因为这些组群代表了光谱非典型的剖面,连接距离大大地超过主聚变阈值。
为了保持统计稳健性并确保有足够的样本规模用于下游分析,这些孤立的剖面图被归为单一的复合外层类别。 颜色黑色( C)

blocks.en: 4 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and preprocessing
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和预处理

blocks.en: We conducted all experiments using four publicly available chest X-ray datasets commonly employed for disease classification:
blocks.zh: 我们使用四种常用的用于疾病分类的胸X射线数据集进行了所有实验:

blocks.en: CheXpert Irvin et al. (2019) . A large-scale dataset from Stanford containing frontal and lateral views, labeled for 14 thoracic findings using report-derived NLP. MIMIC-CXR Johnson et al. (2019) . A de-identified dataset from Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center with paired radiology reports and substantial acquisition and population diversity. PadChest Bustos et al. (2020) . A Spanish dataset with multi-view radiographs and detailed labels covering findings, diagnoses, and anatomical locations. NIH ChestX-ray14 Wang et al. (2017) . A frontal-view dataset labeled for 14 conditions via report mining, notable for heterogeneous acquisition and label noise, making it a common robustness benchmark.
blocks.zh: 切克斯珀特·伊尔文等 (2019). 一个来自斯坦福的大型数据集,包含正面和平面视图,用报告衍生的NLP标注了14个胸肌分泌结果. MIMIC-CXR Johnson等 (2019年). Beth Israel Deaconess医疗中心的解析数据集,并附有配对放射学报告以及大量获取和人口多样性。 PadChest Bustos 等 (2020) (英语). 一个西班牙数据集,包含多视图放射图和详细标签,涵盖发现、诊断和解剖位置。 北爱尔兰 胸X射线14 王等 (2017) (中文(简体) ). 通过报告开采为14个条件贴上标签的正面视图数据集,因不同获取和标签噪音而出名,使其成为一个共同的稳健基准。

blocks.en: To ensure comparability of Fourier transforms and radial spectral profiles across datasets, we standardized image dimensions while preserving spectral geometry. We selected 264×224 as the target resolution, as it was the most common size across sources. Images were resized isotropically by fixing the height to 224 pixels while preserving aspect ratio. In the Fourier domain, isotropic resizing corresponds to a uniform rescaling of frequencies and avoids the geometric distortions that anisotropic resizing would introduce. This is particularly important for radial averaging, which assumes isotropic spectral structure: anisotropic scaling would induce elliptical distortions and bias the radial profile. Although interpolation during resizing may slightly attenuate high-frequency components, the procedure was applied uniformly across samples, preserving the relative spectral structure underlying our analysis. Minimal center-cropping was then performed to obtain identical final dimensions, and samples with incompatible aspect ratios were excluded to avoid excessive rescaling or truncation. \color black
blocks.zh: 为确保Fourier变换和横跨数据集的光谱剖面的可比性,我们在维护光谱几何的同时,将图像维度标准化. 我们选择了264x224作为目标分辨率,因为它是源头最常见的大小. 图像通过将高度固定为224像素,同时保留了外观比来进行同位素调整. 在Fourier域中,同位素再成正比对应频率的统一再成正比,并避免异位素再成正比将引入的几何扭曲. 这对光圈平均特别重要,因为光圈平均假定了同分光谱结构:异同位素缩放会诱发椭圆扭曲和偏差光圈剖面. 虽然在调整规模时的内插可能略微削弱高频组件,但该程序在样本中得到了统一应用,从而保持了我们的分析所依据的相对光谱结构。 然后进行最小中收割,以获得相同的最终尺寸,排除了有不相容方面比率的样品,以避免过度缩放或截取。 颜色黑色( C)

blocks.en: We focus on three clinically common findings: Atelectasis, Consolidation, and Pleural Effusion. We trained our models in a mono-pathology setting. For each pathology, we constructed separate training and validation splits. The training sets are exclusively based on CheXpert images. Table details the datasets sizes. The test sets are built from each dataset, so MIMIC-CXR, PadChest, and NIH are unseen-domain in our evaluation. This enables the analysis of cross-dataset generalization under distributional shift.
blocks.zh: 我们集中研究了三种临床上常见的发现:Atelectasis, Construction,和Pleural Efunation. 我们训练我们的模型 在一个单一病理环境。 对于每一种病理,我们分别建造了训练与鉴定分会. 训练套完全取自切克珀特的相片. 表详细列出数据集大小. 测试集由每个数据集构建,因此MIMIC-CXR,PadChest,以及NIH在我们的评价中都是隐蔽域. 这样可以分析分布相变下的跨数据集通论.

blocks.en: For experiments that require large-scale validation, we derived a unified Global test set by pooling the test subsets from every datasets. \color black
blocks.zh: 对于需要大规模验证的实验,我们通过汇集每个数据集的测试子集,得出一个统一的"全球"测试集. 颜色黑色( C)

blocks.en: 4.2 Models, training and performance assessment
blocks.zh: 4.2 模式、培训和业绩评估

blocks.en:
For all experiments, we trained a DenseNet-121 Huang et al. (2018) classifier using binary cross-entropy loss and the Adam Kingma and Ba (2017) optimizer (learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} ).
A Reduce-on-Plateau scheduler (minimum learning rate 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} ) and a batch size of 16 were used.
Models were trained for up to 30 epochs with early stopping based on validation performance.
All training was performed on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 GPU.
blocks.zh:
对所有实验,我们训练了一台使用二进制交叉收缩损耗的DenseNet-121 Huang等人(2018年)分级器和Adam Kingma和Ba(2017年)优化器(学习率1×10-4 1\times 10\times 10\times 4},体重衰变1×10~3 1\times 10\times 10\times 3}).
使用了一个Plateau排程器(最低学习率1×10−5 1\times 10×5}),批量大小为16个。
模型接受了30个世纪的培训,根据验证性能提前停止。
所有培训都用NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 GPU进行。

blocks.en:
We report the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (AUROC) to evaluate the discriminative performance of the models.
This metric was chosen for its invariance to decision thresholds and its robustness to the fluctuating prevalence in unsupervised clustering assignments.
blocks.zh:
我们报告接收者操作特征下的区域,以评估模型的歧视性性能。
之所以选择这一衡量标准,是因为它与决策阈值不一致,而且它在无监督的集群任务中,其强势性与波动的普遍性有关。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and results
blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Relevance of RAPS descriptors for performance analysis
blocks.zh: 5.1 RAPS描述符与业绩分析的相关性

blocks.en:
Given a K-medoids partition of the RAPS descriptors (Section 3.3 ), we use the standard deviation of the AUROC across the K K clusters to measure how effectively the partition stratifies performance.
To isolate the effect of spectral coherence from artifacts of cluster size or class distribution, we implement two stochastic baselines: a fully random (FR) assignment and a pseudo-random (PR) control that preserves the specific cluster size and label statistics of the K-medoids solution.
To study the impact of granularity, we repeat the above experiment for values of K K ranging from 2 2 to 10 10 . We then average the results over 50 seeds to reduce variability from K-medoids initialization and baseline stochasticity.
blocks.zh:
考虑到RAPS描述符的K-medoids分区(第3.3节),我们使用AUROC的标准偏差跨了K组群来测量分区分层如何有效分层性能.
为了将光谱一致性的效果从集群大小或类分布的文物中分离出来,我们实施两个有分量的基线:完全随机(FR)任务和伪随机(PR)控制,保留了K-medoids溶液的特定集群大小和标签统计.
为了研究颗粒性的影响,我们重复上述K值在2至10-10之间的实验。 然后,我们平均得出50多颗种子,以减少K-medoids初始化和基线花样的可变性。

blocks.en: To demonstrate the consistency of our findings across varying model architectures, we replicated the experiments using both ResNet He et al. (2015) and EfficientNet Tan and Le (2020) architectures; these results are detailed in Appendix B . \color black
blocks.zh: 为了表明我们在不同模式架构中的调查结果的一致性,我们利用ResNet He等人(2015年)和 " 高效率的Tan和Le " (2020年)架构复制了这些实验;这些结果详见附录B。 颜色黑色( C)

blocks.en: As shown in fig:kmedoids2_corr, the dispersion of AUROC in the K-medoids partitions of RAPS profiles (blue) remains consistently above those of both random baselines, sometimes reaching nearly twice as high. Importantly, the pseudo-random baseline (red) preserves the exact cluster size distribution and class proportions of the K-medoids solution, while discarding any organization based on spectral similarity. This control ensures that the observed variability cannot be attributed merely to differences in cluster size or label imbalance.
blocks.zh: 如图:kmedoids2_corr所示,RAPS剖面(蓝色)的K-medoids分区中AUROC的分布始终高于两个随机基线,有时达到近两倍高. 重要的是,假随机基线(红色)保留了K-medoids溶液的精确集群大小分布和分级比例,同时根据光谱相似性抛弃了任何组织. 这种控制确保所观察到的可变性不能仅仅归因于集群大小或标签不平衡的差异.

blocks.en: Moreover, all results are averaged over 50 random seeds to further reduce stochastic effects arising from K-medoids initialization and from random cluster composition. The persistent and substantially larger gap between the blue and red curves indicates that the partitions induced by the correlation distance between RAPS profiles capture genuine heterogeneity in model behavior.
blocks.zh: 此外,所有结果平均都超过50个随机种子,以进一步减少由K-medoids初始化和随机集群组成所产生的花样效应。 蓝色和红色曲线之间的持续和大得多的差距表明,由RAPS剖面的相干距离所引发的分区在模型行为中捕捉出真正的异性.

blocks.en: The consistency of this effect across all pathologies (see Appendix A ), across different classifier architectures (ResNet, EfficientNet, and DenseNet; Appendix B ), and for all values of K K reinforces our confidence that spectral representations derived from Fourier analysis explain a meaningful portion of the observed performance variability. \color black
blocks.zh: 在所有病理学(见附录A),不同分类器结构(ResNet, ExecutiveNet, 和 DenseNet;附录B)之间,以及对于K K的所有值,这种效果的一致性,加强了我们的信心,即从Fourier分析中得出的光谱表示可以解释所观察到的性能可变性中有意义的部分。 颜色黑色( C)

blocks.en: Because the correlation distance emphasizes shape differences, this gap suggests that differences in spectral composition—such as the relative distribution of low versus high frequencies, decay rates, or local spectral slopes—are systematically associated with differences in model performance.
blocks.zh: 由于相关距离强调形状差异,这一差距表明,光谱构成的差异——如低频与高频的相对分布、衰减率或局部光谱坡度——与模型性能的差异有系统联系。

blocks.en: 5.2 Influence of the similarity metric on performance stratification
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 类似性衡量尺度对业绩分层的影响

blocks.en: To assess how the distance metric influences the K-medoids performance stratification, we compare three metrics on the radial profiles: Euclidean, Spearman, and correlation. The evaluation follows the same protocol as in Section 5.1 , with AUROC variability compared to the FR and PR baselines and averaged over multiple seeds.
blocks.zh: 为了评估距离测量法如何影响K-medoids的性能分层,我们比较了射线剖面上的3个测量法:欧几利得、斯皮尔曼和相关性。 评估遵循与第5.1节相同的规程,与FR和PR基线相比,AUROC的可变性和多种子的平均值。

blocks.en: Across all values of K K , the correlation distance produces the largest separation between the clustering curve and both baselines (fig:ablation_atelectasis). The Spearman distance induces greater variability than the Euclidean distance, though still below the correlation distance.
blocks.zh: 在所有K K 的值中,相通相距在组合曲线和两个基线(fig:ablation_atelectasis)之间产生最大的分离. 斯皮尔曼相距比欧克利德相距更能诱发多变性,虽然仍然低于相干相距.

blocks.en:
By contrast, the L 2 L_{2} distance shows only limited gains over the baselines, suggesting that amplitude-based similarities contribute little to the stratification of performance compared to differences in the shape of the spectral profiles.
This ordering among metrics indicates that the performance variability is more closely related to the relative distribution of spectral energy than to its absolute magnitude.
Metrics that are invariant to global scaling and affine transformations, such as the correlation distance and, to a lesser extent, the Spearman distance, capture spectral characteristics that are more informative for distinguishing model behavior.
This supports the choice of the correlation distance in our clustering framework and is consistent with Section 5.1 , where it produces the largest performance disparities across clusters.
blocks.zh:
相形之下,L2 L_{2}相去相去仅显示在基线上的增益有限,说明与光谱剖面的形状相去甚远相比,以振幅为基础的相似性对性能分层作用不大.
这种在指标中排列的顺序表明,性能可变性与光谱能的相对分布比与它的绝对量更密切相关.
与全球缩放和近缘变换不相适应的量子,如相通相相相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相相通相通相通相通相相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相
这有助于选择我们分组框架中的关联距离,并符合第5.1节,其中产生各分组之间最大的业绩差异。

blocks.en: These findings suggest that DG and DA strategies based on the frequency domain should not focus exclusively on matching absolute spectral energy distributions, as is often done in methods that impose target spectra or mix frequency components directly. Instead, our results indicate that the relative structure of the radial spectrum, such as the balance between low and high frequencies and the rate at which spectral energy decays, plays a more consequential role. Methods that explicitly account for these relative spectral characteristics may therefore offer a more effective direction for adaptation and robustness.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,基于频率域的DG和DA策略不应完全专注于匹配绝对光谱能分布,如在直接强制设定目标光谱或混合频率组件的方法中经常这样做. 相反,我们的结果表明,光谱的相对结构,如低频和高频的平衡以及光谱能衰减的速度,起着更会产生影响的作用。 因此,明确反映这些相对光谱特性的方法可以为适应和稳健性提供更有效的方向。

blocks.en: 5.3 Slice discovery and outlier detection
blocks.zh: 5.3 切片发现和外出检测

blocks.en:
To confirm the robustness of our data-centric framework, we apply HAC in the space of RAPS descriptors to isolate under-performing data slices on unseen domain data.
After clustering, we assess the AUROC on each cluster to pinpoint specific spectral regions where model performance deviates from the norm.
blocks.zh:
为了确认我们以数据为中心的框架的稳健性,我们在RAPS描述符的空间中应用HAC来隔离未见域数据上表现不佳的数据片段.
分组后,我们评估每个分组的AUROC,以确定模型性能偏离规范的特定光谱区.

blocks.en:
As depicted in fig:outliers_2, the AUROC across HAC clusters exhibits distinct and variable performance levels for all pathologies and external validation centers.
This finding mirrors the performance stratification observed with the K-medoids clustering approach.
This convergence confirms that the spectral differences encoded through the correlation distance reliably capture meaningful variations in model performance, regardless of the underlying clustering algorithm employed.
blocks.zh:
如图:outliers_2所描述的,整个HAC集群的AUROC在所有病理和外部验证中心表现出不同和可变的性能水平.
这一发现反映了用K-medoids集群方法观察到的性能分层。
这种趋同证实,通过相关距离编码的光谱差异可靠地捕捉模型性能的有意义的变化,而不论所使用的是何种基本的集群算法.

blocks.en:
Importantly, we demonstrate that across almost all considered datasets and pathologies, the proposed method systematically isolates a cluster exhibiting significantly degraded AUROC (bars on the far right of the different plots).
This consistency underscores the efficacy of applying HAC to RAPS descriptors for slice discovery, as it reliably uncovers latent subgroups where model performance is compromised.
blocks.zh:
重要的是,我们表明,在几乎所有被考虑的数据集和病理中,拟议方法系统地隔离一个显示严重退化的AUROC(不同地块最右边的栏杆)的集群。
这种一致性突出了将HAC应用于RAPS描述器以进行切片发现的功效,因为它可靠地揭示出潜在的子群,其中模型性能受损.

blocks.en: Additionally, a particularly characteristic and instructive pattern emerged from the analysis of the outlier super-group (red), which was formally defined by merging all HAC clusters containing fewer than 10 10 samples. The AUROC for this super-group consistently exhibited a marked separation from the performance mean of the main clusters. Specifically, the performance was frequently significantly lower; as observed, for example, in Atelectasis and Pleural Effusion on the MIMIC and NIH datasets, and in Consolidation on Padchest and MIMIC; indicating substantial failure concentration. Conversely, in select cases, the AUROC was noticeably higher (e.g., Atelectasis and Pleural Effusion on Padchest), but critically, it was never comparable to the average cluster performance.
blocks.zh: 此外,在对外部超群(红色)的分析中出现了一种特别的特征和具有启发性的模式,这种超群是通过将含有不到10个样本的所有HAC群合并而正式确定的。 这个超级组群的AUROC一直显示出与主要组群的性能平均值的明显区别. 具体地说,表现往往要低得多;例如,在MIMIC和NIH数据集上的Atelectasis和Pleural Efunation,以及在Padchest和MIMIMIC上的合并;显示大量故障集中。 反之,在某些情况中,AUROC明显较高(例如Padchest上的Atelectasis和Pleural Efunation),但关键是,它从未与平均集群性能相媲美。

blocks.en: As suggested by the analyses in Appendix C and D , these variations in performance are not readily attributable to observable visual or demographic differences alone. \color black Therefore, this consistent performance separation provides strong quantitative evidence: slices possessing atypical spectral signatures reliably translate into performance-level outliers within the model.
blocks.zh: 如附录C和D分析所示,这些性能差异并非仅归因于可见的视觉或人口差异。 颜色黑色( C) 因此,这种一致的性能分离提供了强有力的定量证据:拥有非典型光谱特征的切片在模型中可靠地转化为性能水平的外延.

blocks.en: We also evaluated the model on seen-domain images with the CheXpert test dataset. As shown in fig:seen_hac, the performance on the outlier super-group is not markedly different from that of the other clusters. This outcome is expected: because the model was trained exclusively on this domain, it learned to handle the full range of RAPS variations present in the training distribution. Nevertheless, we still observe clusters with distinct performance levels, indicating that HAC can partition the domain into meaningful RAPS subsets on which the model performs comparatively better or worse.
blocks.zh: 我们还用CheXpert测试数据集评估了视域图像模型。 如图:seen_hac所示,在外超群上的表现与其他群组没有明显区别. 预期结果如下:由于该模式只接受过该领域的培训,因此它学会了处理培训分配中存在的各种RAPS变化。 尽管如此,我们仍然观察到具有不同性能水平的集群,表明HAC可以将域分出成有意义的RAPS子集,模型在其中的性能比较好或差.

blocks.en: 5.4 Comparison with OOD detection baselines
blocks.zh: 5.4 与OD检测基线的比较

blocks.en: Beyond internal performance stratification, we further evaluate whether the proposed spectral framework can effectively identify performance-degrading samples in an out-of-distribution (OOD) setting. To this end, we compare RAPS-based outlier detection against established OOD baselines: Lee et al. (2018) and Tardy et al. (2019) . Table presents the AUROC difference ( Δ \Delta ) relative to the global test set for each experiment. Our results show that HAC of RAPS more consistently isolates OOD clusters with performance levels significantly lower than the baseline. This trend is further evidenced by the mean absolute difference, where HAC of RAPS achieves 0.103, compared to 0.077 and 0.053 for the baselines. Importantly, while both SOTA methods are supervised, HAC of RAPS is fully unsupervised, making it independent to the annotation or borderline cases. \color black
blocks.zh: 除了内部性能分层外,我们进一步评价拟议的光谱框架是否能够有效确定分配外环境中的性能分级样本。 为此,我们将基于RAPS的外部检测与确定的OD基线进行比较: Lee等 (2018)和Tardy等 (2019). 表列出了AUROC相对于每个实验的全局测试集的相差( \\ Delta ). 我们的结果表明,RAPS的HAC更一贯地隔离OD集群,其性能水平大大低于基准. 这一趋势进一步表现在平均绝对差异上,RAPS的HAC达到0.103分,而基线为0.077分和0.053分. 重要的是,虽然这两种SOTA方法都受到监督,但RAPS的HAC完全不受监督,使其独立于注释或边缘案例。 颜色黑色( C)

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced a data-centric framework that uses Fourier-domain analysis to examine performance variability in chest X-ray classifiers. Representing each image through its Radially Averaged Power Spectrum (RAPS) yielded model-agnostic descriptors capturing acquisition-level signal properties. Across experiments, K-medoids and hierarchical clustering consistently revealed meaningful differences in model behavior across groups defined by their spectral profiles, with hierarchical clustering further isolating small sets of images whose atypical frequency patterns were matched by equally atypical performance across evaluation domains.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了以数据为中心的框架,利用傅里叶域分析来检查胸X光分级器的性能可变性. 通过辐射平均能谱(RAPS)来代表每个图像,生成模型不可知描述符,捕捉获取级信号属性。 在整个实验中,K-medoids和分级组合一致地揭示出其光谱剖面所定义的各组群体在模式行为方面的有意义的差异,分级组合进一步孤立了几组小图像,其非典型频率模式在各评价领域都有同样非典型的表现相匹配。

blocks.en: Ablations over similarity metrics clarified which components of the spectral representation matter most. Correlation distance produced the strongest separation between clusters, indicating that performance differences relate primarily to the relative distribution of spectral energy, its shape and rate of decay, rather than to absolute magnitude. This identifies the spectral characteristics most relevant to model behavior and motivates approaches that explicitly account for such relative frequency patterns.
blocks.zh: 与类似度测量值相比的偏差澄清了光谱代表值的哪些组成部分最为重要。 相通相距产生星团间最强的相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相通相相通相通相通相通相通相相通相相通相相相相相相相通相通相相相通相相相通相相相通相相通相通相通相相相通相通相相相相相相相通相相相相相相相通相相相通相相相相相相相相通相 这确定了与模型行为最相关的光谱特征并激发了明确反映这种相对频率模式的方法.

blocks.en: Together, these findings point to limitations of metadata- or embedding-based slice discovery. Signal-level irregularities rooted in acquisition physics, preprocessing, or frequency composition form predictive patterns that standard monitoring pipelines overlook. Spectral analysis therefore provides a principled and interpretable means of exposing these hidden strata and improving performance auditing. Beyond error analysis, our results suggest that robustness and adaptation strategies may benefit from targeting spectral structure directly, particularly the balance between low and high frequencies, offering a more physically grounded avenue for improving generalization in medical imaging.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,基于元数据或嵌入法的切片发现存在局限性。 信号层的不规则根植于获取物理,预处理,或频率组成形成预测规律,标准监测管道忽略了这些规律. 因此,光谱分析为揭露这些隐蔽的阶层和改进业绩审计提供了一个有原则和可解释的手段。 除了误差分析外,我们的结果还表明,直接瞄准光谱结构,特别是低频和高频之间的平衡,可能有利于稳健性和适应性战略,为改进医疗成像的通俗化提供了更实际的途径。

For Pleural Effusion cases from the NIH center, we compare the AUROC of the worst slice isolated by our method with traditional slicing by available metadata attributes, i.e. age, gender, and view. As demonstrated in Table , metadata slicing sometimes fails to identify performance-degrading subsets, resulting in only minor AUROC variations.
In contrast, our data-centric framework successfully isolates a highly vulnerable data slice that exhibits a substantial and critical performance drop.
This result definitively establishes our method as an effective complementary solution for automated failure mode discovery.

对于来自NIH中心的静脉输液病例,我们用我们的方法将最糟糕的片段AUROC与现有的元数据属性即年龄、性别和视图的传统切分进行比较。 如表.所示,元数据切分有时无法识别性能降低子集,只导致AUROC的微小变化.
相比之下,我们以数据为中心的框架成功地分离出一个高度脆弱的数据片段,显示出显著和关键的性能下降。
这一结果明确确定了我们的方法,作为自动化故障模式发现的有效补充解决方案。
